sources.title: 大阪市基本構想
sources.review_boundary: The citywide basic concept and its three urban visions are verified as the top-level direction. No fixed plan end year is asserted from this landing, and individual policy targets or outcome claims remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 令和8年度 市政運営の基本方針
sources.review_boundary: The annual citywide management policy is verified as the cross-city implementation direction for fiscal 2026. It is not a multi-year implementation plan, and individual initiatives remain separate until record-level review.

sources.title: 令和6年度各区・局運営方針に係る評価
sources.review_boundary: Osaka performs progress review through ward and bureau operating policies, with quantitative outcome status, self-evaluation, and future direction published by each organization. These decentralized self-evaluations are not aggregated into a single Jichi Insight citywide achievement score.

sources.title: 令和8年度（2026年度）当初予算（令和8年3月27日議決）
sources.review_boundary: The enacted fiscal 2026 initial budget is verified. The general-account resolution includes an attached resolution, and general, special, enterprise, bureau-level, initial, and supplementary fiscal evidence remain distinct.

sources.title: 令和6年度決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 settlement landing for general and ordinance-based special accounts is verified. Public-enterprise accounts, ordinary-account statistics, financial statements, and project-level results remain separate evidence layers.

quality_boundary: Osaka City's policy system is represented according to its actual structure: a citywide basic concept, an annual city-management policy, and decentralized ward and bureau operating policies with their own progress reviews. Jichi Insight does not invent a separate multi-year implementation plan or aggregate decentralized self-evaluations into a citywide score. Budget, settlement, project, outcome, and self-evaluation evidence remain Indexed and are not promoted to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status without record-level review.
next_action: Enumerate all fiscal 2026 ward and bureau operating policies, map their management issues and outcome indicators to the citywide policy direction, retain organizational boundaries, and connect fiscal 2026 budget and fiscal 2024 settlement records only where project identity, account, period, unit, and responsibility are verified.
